name: Shiba
source:
Sunny, likes tricks, and likes to help others, Shiba is a leading character in the class. He is seen as someone who is fashionable and smart person, but...?

"No, I can't. I can't keep being like this, or I will not be proud of my race."

[Edited from [url=http://hunex-play.com/portal/002/en]Official site[/url]]
